topic.title: Your Samosa Didn't Get Expensive On Its Own
topic.claim: Food prices creep up one rupee at a time so you never notice the real hike happening upstream.
topic.behaviour: Oil companies raised commercial LPG cylinder prices sharply while keeping the politically sensitive domestic cylinder price flat for the fifth straight month.
topic.mechanism: Protecting the visible domestic price looks good in a headline, letting the invisible commercial price absorb the hit, which then reaches you slowly, through the shopkeeper's plate, not a news story.
topic.group: anyone who's noticed their regular food order got quietly pricier
topic.moment: Your regular chai-samosa stall bumps the price by a few rupees, and you don't think twice about it.

turn.believed: Small vendors raise prices because costs rise everywhere, equally, all the time.
turn.actually: Commercial LPG, what every dhaba and food stall runs on, just got a steep hike, while the domestic cylinder stayed untouched.

topic.because: The domestic cylinder price is the one everyone notices, so it stays flat for optics, while the commercial cylinder quietly absorbs the real cost and small vendors pass it on, plate by plate.

proof.fact: Commercial 19kg LPG cylinder prices rose ₹62.50 to ₹71.50 across cities from October 1, while the domestic 14.2kg cylinder stayed unchanged for a fifth straight month

topic.payoff: When a price climbs a few rupees at a time, somewhere upstream, a bigger number just moved.
topic.send_to: anyone who's noticed their usual food order got pricier for no obvious reason
real_details: Patna saw the steepest commercial LPG hike, up ₹71.50 to ₹3,100.50
A ₹5 Lays packet marketed as 11g+1.3g actually weighed 4.32g on a gold scale
Tea alone now costs ₹20-30 in some places
Hyderabad street corners still serve a hot, filling breakfast for ₹25
topic.why_now: Shows up in food prices exactly as festive spending peaks

score.why: The chai-samosa price creep is something everyone's noticed and shrugged off; connecting it to the domestic-cylinder-stays-flat-for-optics trick gives it a because nobody had.
